events.title: What Are Logs and How to Use Them
events.description: leste explained what 'logs' are in stealer-malware context — dumped browser passwords, cookies, sessions, wallets — and discussed which countries are considered high value and how people monetize that data, with a reminder of the legal and security risks.

events.title: Best OS for local LLM?
events.description: Hackers asked what OS members prefer for running local LLMs, sparking a discussion comparing Linux distros, Windows, and macOS with Apple Silicon — covering performance, drivers, VRAM, and dev-comfort considerations.

events.title: [Quantum] I Gave AI a Budget to Find and Purchase the Best Black Friday Deals
events.description: Oh_Well handed PayPal balance to an AI-powered browser agent on Black Friday and let it scan stores, track price history, avoid fake discounts, stack coupons, and auto-checkout — saving roughly €985 across action cams, smart home gear, robot vacuums and more.

events.title: What's a Random Skill You Picked Up That Ended Up Helping You Later?
events.description: Axelyn opened a reflection thread about accidental skills — random things picked up from a hobby or boredom that turned out useful — sharing how casual Canva use evolved into a money-saving, gig-generating skill.

events.title: What did you do for Thanksgiving?
events.description: JoshAllen, though not from the US, asked the community how they spent Thanksgiving. The thread became a feel-good roundup of family dinners, time off, and solo chill days.
